label: STOPP L4: lignocaine patch for osteoarthritis pain
title: Lignocaine patch for osteoarthritis pain
statement: Topical lidocaine (lignocaine) patch for treatment of chronic osteoarthritis pain (lack of evidence of efficacy).

source.document: O'Mahony D, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632, Appendix 1 (corrected supplementary file; NHS Somerset copy used for text, sentence-identical to the earlier parse)
source.citation: O'Mahony D, Cherubini A, Guiteras AR, et al. STOPP/START criteria for potentially inappropriate prescribing in older people: version 3. Eur Geriatr Med 2023;14:625-632. doi:10.1007/s41999-023-00777-y

plain_summary: Lignocaine (lidocaine) patches have not been shown to help long-lasting osteoarthritis pain.

medicine_groups.name: Lidocaine patches
medicine_groups.note: Medicated skin patches only. Lignocaine is another name for lidocaine. Nervoderm and Versatis are Australian lidocaine patches. Creams, gels, sprays and injections do not count.

needs_facts.what: Pain condition the lignocaine patch is used for
needs_facts.meets: The record links this lidocaine patch to chronic osteoarthritis pain.

rule_for_models: At age 65 or older, flag a lidocaine patch linked to chronic osteoarthritis pain and cite the supply and indication (if age alone is unknown, report only a possible finding and ask for age), but give no finding for a patch documented solely for another indication. When the indication or chronicity is unclear, report only a possible finding and identify the missing detail. Ask how long this osteoarthritis pain has been present and let the pharmacist judge borderline chronicity.
cannot_be_seen: The reason the patch was prescribed, where it is worn, whether it was bought without a prescription or supplied elsewhere, and whether the person has both osteoarthritis and nerve pain.
ask_the_gp: A review of whether the lignocaine patch is helping the osteoarthritis pain and whether it should continue.
